I shipped nothing for this task. The right-column overlap is already gone, and the repeated alert is a copy his 10-15 order requires.

- **Overlap in screen 34:** At 1080p the right column in the downed state has no two text boxes touching. The 4K picture scales the same way. I didn't shoot the P2 window, because the HUD uses the same draw code for both seats. Nothing to fix.
- **Repeated alert in screen 33:** It's now two copies, not three. "the pillbox has seen you" shows as the red banner and again as a row in the left feed. "location revealed" and "running slowly" do the same. The feed copy comes from his 10-15 order that all on-screen text also goes into the player feed. Removing it would reverse that order, so I left it. His question about this is open as number 91 in `questions.md`.
- **Critic scores:** Both screens scored 2 on the earlier HEAD pictures (34 on a flat downed card and wrapping run-info rows; 33 on the duplicate alerts and a controls cheat-sheet in the centre). I didn't re-score them. The raid HUD hasn't changed since, though the game file is now at v34.33. Both are still under their target of 4.
- **Next work, for its own task:** Restyle the downed card as the standard panel, and fix the wrapping run-info rows.

I logged this rerun in `tools/handoff/console/notes/106-ui-raid-column-overlaps.md`.
